label: create real marked lab and launch private tmux through product lab_run
command:
set -eu
REPO=$PWD
LAB=$1
"$REPO/bin/fm-lab-home.sh" create "$LAB"
mkdir -p "$LAB/tmux"
# Load the product's launch function without running up's trust/account workflow.
source "$REPO/bin/fm-live-lab.sh" --help >/dev/null
ROOT=$LAB
TMUX_DIR="$LAB/tmux"
CLAUDE_DIR=
printf 'parent soft=%s hard=%s\n' "$(ulimit -S -u)" "$(ulimit -H -u)"
lab_run tmux -L fm-lab -f /dev/null new-session -d -s budget-proof -n first -x 120 -y 40 -c "$REPO" "$2"
printf 'server='
env -u TMUX TMUX_TMPDIR="$TMUX_DIR" tmux -L fm-lab display-message -p -t budget-proof '#{pid} socket=#{socket_path} grid=#{window_width}x#{window_height}'
bash -c 'printf "pane=first soft=%s hard=%s pid=%s grid=%s\n" "$(ulimit -S -u)" "$(ulimit -H -u)" "$$" "$COLUMNS/$LINES"; sleep 60'

label: launch second pane via unbudgeted client to prove server inheritance
command: bash -c 'ulimit -u 99999 2>/dev/null; raise_rc=$?; printf "pane=second soft=%s hard=%s raise_exit=%s pid=%s\n" "$(ulimit -S -u)" "$(ulimit -H -u)" "$raise_rc" "$$"; sleep 60'
